research_scope: Comprehensive analysis of commercially available natural mineral waters with unique ion balances (e.g., calcium without chloride, magnesium without sulfate, high sulfate, high buffer) designed to complement standard coffee-water brewing salts.

candidates.name: Magnesia
candidates.verification_notes: duplicate_risk: Ensure you are using the natural mineral water, not flavored variants. High magnesium bicarbonate source.
candidates.why_it_is_useful: Provides a massive dose of magnesium bicarbonate without introducing unwanted sulfates or chlorides. Essential for creating high-Mg buffer solutions. WARNING: Carbonated, must be completely degassed before use.

candidates.name: Contrex
candidates.verification_notes: Highly mineralized. Exceptional sulfate to chloride ratio.
candidates.why_it_is_useful: An incredible source of calcium and sulfate without the sodium or chloride baggage. Useful for dialing in high-sulfate profiles for enhanced perceived acidity in light roasts.

candidates.name: Courmayeur
candidates.verification_notes: One of the highest calcium sulfate natural waters available commercially with virtually zero sodium or chloride.
candidates.why_it_is_useful: Isolates calcium and sulfate additions almost perfectly. With 0.5mg/L chloride and 1.2mg/L sodium, it allows for pure Ca/SO4 structural adjustments.

candidates.name: Aqua Carpatica (Naturally Sparkling)
candidates.verification_notes: duplicate_risk: The 'Still' version of Aqua Carpatica has completely different, much lower mineralization (Ca 50, Mg 16). Ensure values are applied only to the Naturally Sparkling variant.
candidates.why_it_is_useful: Enormous bicarbonate buffer capacity with incredibly low sodium (5.3mg/L). Ideal for adding natural buffer and hardness without sodium-induced flavor taint. WARNING: Carbonated, must be completely degassed before use.

candidates.name: Evian
candidates.verification_notes: Widely available globally, highly consistent profile.
candidates.why_it_is_useful: The benchmark 3:1 Calcium to Magnesium bicarbonate water. Serves as a perfect classic base water that can be slightly diluted with RO for medium-dark roasts or used straight for traditional espresso.

candidates.name: Volvic
candidates.verification_notes: Classic soft water with a notable silica content.
candidates.why_it_is_useful: Provides a clean, low-TDS canvas with naturally high silica which contributes to enhanced mouthfeel. Excellent base for building custom profiles with salt additions.

candidates.name: Mountain Valley Spring Water
candidates.verification_notes: One of the highest quality US domestic spring waters for coffee.
candidates.why_it_is_useful: Excellent calcium bicarbonate dominant source with negligible chlorides and sulfates. Great base for adding targeted magnesium or sulfate salts.

candidates.name: Hildon
candidates.verification_notes: duplicate_risk: Hildon produces a gently sparkling version; ensure you are using the still version or degassing appropriately.
candidates.why_it_is_useful: Offers incredibly high calcium with near-zero magnesium. Perfect for exploring pure calcium-driven extractions or balancing with magnesium chloride.

candidates.name: Vittel
candidates.verification_notes: Profile may shift slightly depending on exact well within the source, but sulfate and calcium remain consistently high.
candidates.why_it_is_useful: Provides a robust, balanced 1:1 ratio of calcium bicarbonate to calcium sulfate. Excellent for pushing extraction and acidity simultaneously.

candidates.name: San Pellegrino
candidates.verification_notes: Artificially carbonated with naturally sourced CO2. Moderately high chloride.
candidates.why_it_is_useful: A globally accessible high-sulfate, high-hardness blending component. Useful when you need to introduce aggressive sulfate and calcium structures. WARNING: Carbonated, must be completely degassed before use.

candidates.name: Acqua Panna
candidates.verification_notes: Classic soft water standard.
candidates.why_it_is_useful: A near-perfectly balanced soft water out of the bottle for filter coffee, minimizing the need for manual RO blending.

candidates.name: Solan de Cabras
candidates.verification_notes: Excellent Spanish mineral water often found in blue glass/plastic bottles.
candidates.why_it_is_useful: Hits the sweet spot of a 2:1 Calcium to Magnesium ratio with a solid bicarbonate buffer and negligible sodium/chloride.

candidates.name: Zaros
candidates.verification_notes: Award-winning water for low sodium content.
candidates.why_it_is_useful: Offers a highly desirable soft profile with practically zero sodium or chloride. Ready to brew for light roasts immediately.

candidates.name: Wattwiller
candidates.verification_notes: Famously markets itself as having zero sodium.
candidates.why_it_is_useful: One of the only mainstream waters to report literal 0mg/L sodium, paired with a perfect gentle Ca/Mg bicarbonate profile.

candidates.name: Orezza
candidates.verification_notes: Highly effervescent, iron is naturally removed prior to bottling.
candidates.why_it_is_useful: An extreme calcium bicarbonate source without the heavy magnesium or sodium often found in high-bicarbonate waters. WARNING: Carbonated, must be completely degassed before use.

candidates.name: Donat Mg
candidates.verification_notes: Extremely high mineralization. Used primarily for health and digestion.
candidates.why_it_is_useful: Acts as a potent liquid mineral concentrate. Even a few milliliters in RO water will drastically spike magnesium, sulfate, and bicarbonate. Must be measured like a chemical solution. WARNING: Carbonated, must be completely degassed before use.

candidates.name: Borsec
candidates.verification_notes: duplicate_risk: Ensure naturally carbonated variant is used.
candidates.why_it_is_useful: Massive natural buffer capacity via calcium and magnesium bicarbonate. Low sulfate makes it unique among high-TDS waters. WARNING: Carbonated, must be completely degassed before use.

candidates.name: Fiji
candidates.verification_notes: Famous for its unusually high silica content.
candidates.why_it_is_useful: The high silica content (93mg/L) contributes significant texture and mouthfeel to coffee, while the low overall hardness provides a gentle base for light roasts.

candidates.name: Spa Reine
candidates.verification_notes: One of the lowest TDS natural waters commercially available in Europe.
candidates.why_it_is_useful: Acts as a commercial alternative to RO or distilled water for blending. Perfect when you are traveling and need a near-zero TDS base to add your salts to.

candidates.name: Gerolsteiner
candidates.verification_notes: Classic German high-mineral water.
candidates.why_it_is_useful: A dense, balanced source of calcium and magnesium bicarbonate. Needs severe dilution but acts as an excellent, naturally occurring mineral concentrate. WARNING: Carbonated, must be completely degassed before use.

candidates.name: Highland Spring
candidates.verification_notes: UK supermarket staple.
candidates.why_it_is_useful: Clean, soft, perfectly balanced Ca/Mg base with very low sulfates and chlorides. An ideal brewing water right out of the bottle.

candidates.name: Devin Spring
candidates.verification_notes: duplicate_risk: Do NOT confuse with Devin Mineral, which has high sodium and fluoride.
candidates.why_it_is_useful: Another ultra-low TDS option similar to Spa Reine, ideal as an RO alternative for custom salt building in Eastern Europe.

candidates.name: Antipodes
candidates.verification_notes: Premium high-silica water.
candidates.why_it_is_useful: Provides a very soft base with high silica content for enhanced mouthfeel without the higher buffer found in Fiji.

candidates.name: Mg Mivela
candidates.verification_notes: Rare profile favoring Mg drastically over Ca.
candidates.why_it_is_useful: A phenomenal source of high magnesium bicarbonate. Sodium is present, so it should be used in calculated dilutions. WARNING: Carbonated, must be completely degassed before use.

candidates.name: Voss
candidates.verification_notes: One of the purest globally available artesian waters.
candidates.why_it_is_useful: An ultra-clean, very low TDS canvas for adding salts when RO water is unavailable.

candidates.name: Lanjaron
candidates.verification_notes: A very common and highly consistent Spanish water.
candidates.why_it_is_useful: A pristine soft water base perfectly tailored for filter coffee without needing any dilution.
